Schnittstelle Operator<A>

Typparameter:
A - the operand/result type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Applicable<A,A>, Deferrable<A,A>, Fun<A,A>, Function<A,A>, UnaryOperator<A>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Operator<A> extends UnaryOperator<A>, Fun<A,A>

A unary operator representing a mapping from a set to itself f: A → A.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • operator

      static <A> Operator<A> operator(@NonNull UnaryOperator<A> operator)

      Wraps the given UnaryOperator into an Operator that enforces non-null input and output.

      Typparameter:
      A - the operand type
      Parameter:
      operator - the unary operator to wrap; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Operator delegating to operator
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if operator is null or returns null
      Seit:

    • apply

      @Pure @NonNull A apply(@NonNull A a)

      Applies this operator to the given argument.

      Contract: a must not be null; the result must not be null.

      Angegeben von:
      apply in Schnittstelle Applicable<A,A>
      Angegeben von:
      apply in Schnittstelle Fun<A,A>
      Angegeben von:

      Parameter:

      Gibt zurück:
      the result; never null

    • compose

      default Operator<A> compose(@NonNull Operator<A> before)

      Returns the composition this ∘ before. The resulting operator first applies before, then applies this.

      Contract: before must not be null; intermediate and final results must not be null.

      Parameter:
      before - the operator to apply first; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the composed operator
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if before is null or any intermediate result is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • andThen

      default Operator<A> andThen(@NonNull Operator<A> next)

      Returns the composition next ∘ this. The resulting operator first applies this, then applies next.

      Contract: next must not be null; intermediate and final results must not be null.

      Parameter:
      next - the operator to apply afterwards; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the composed operator
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if next is null or any intermediate result is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0
